fix_connection_recycler.description: Deploy connection recycler sidecar that forcefully reclaims leaked idle connections held >60s
fix_connection_recycler.blast_radius: No service disruption — recycler runs alongside app, closes only idle leaked connections

fix_restart_app.description: Graceful rolling restart of all app instances to clear leaked connections, then deploy hotfix with finally block
fix_restart_app.blast_radius: ~15 seconds of elevated latency during rolling restart; in-flight requests may retry; hotfix requires code review
